name: XCP-075
summary: An XC-family AC servo drive documented in Unisunbot’s official support manual. It uses a single-phase 220 V AC supply and supports position, speed and torque control modes, with an output-power range of 0.75–1 kW. Current availability is unverified.

description.en: An XC-family AC servo drive documented in Unisunbot’s official support manual. It uses a single-phase 220 V AC supply and supports position, speed and torque control modes, with an output-power range of 0.75–1 kW. Current availability is unverified.

specs.label: Braking resistor support
specs.value: Internal and external
specs.conditions: Configuration: XCP-075; named column in XC servo manual table 2.1.; The official current portfolio names XCP-040 and links this XC-family manual. XCP-075 is a separately named manual model; present sales availability is unverified. The table gives nominal AC supply with explicit tolerance and configurable modes.
